name: SIRIUS
intel: Brightest star in Earth's sky. Contains a faint white dwarf companion star.

name: CANOPUS
intel: Used by ancient sailors for navigation. It shines 10,000 times brighter than the Sun.

name: RIGEL KENT
intel: Closest star system to Earth. Contains the planet Proxima b, a potential home for life.

name: ARCTURUS
intel: An ancient star, older than our solar system. Moving rapidly through the galaxy.

name: VEGA
intel: Surrounded by a massive ring of dust and debris. Planets may be forming there now.

name: CAPELLA
intel: A complex system of four stars. Two giant yellow stars orbit each other closely.

name: RIGEL
intel: Massive star burning fuel quickly. Will explode as a supernova eventually.

name: PROCYON
intel: A close neighbor. It has a tiny, dim companion star that is slowly dying.

name: BETELGEUSE
intel: A colossal dying star. It pulses in size and will explode violently soon (cosmically).

name: ACHERNAR
intel: Spins so fast it has flattened into an oval shape instead of a sphere.

name: HADAR
intel: Emits immense heat. A binary system where two heavy stars dance around each other.

name: ALTAIR
intel: Rotates incredibly fast, completing a day in just 9 hours. Bulges at the equator.

name: ACRUX
intel: The bottom star of the Southern Cross. Vital for southern navigation.

name: ALDEBARAN
intel: The 'Eye of the Bull'. NASA's Pioneer 10 probe is heading towards this star.

name: SPICA
intel: Two stars orbiting so close they distort each other into egg shapes.

name: ANTARES
intel: If placed in our system, it would swallow Mars. A massive cloud of gas surrounds it.

name: POLLUX
intel: We have confirmed a gas giant planet orbits this star. The atmosphere is smoky.

name: FOMALHAUT
intel: Looks like the 'Eye of Sauron'. Surrounded by a massive ring of debris and comets.

name: DENEB
intel: One of the farthest stars visible to the naked eye. Incredibly luminous.

name: MIMOSA
intel: A pulsating star. Its surface vibrates like a ringing bell.

name: REGULUS
intel: Actually four stars bound together. The main star spins wildly fast.

name: ADHERA
intel: Source of extreme Ultraviolet radiation. Dangerous for unshielded vessels.

name: SHAULA
intel: The 'Stinger' of the scorpion. Emits strong X-rays.

name: CASTOR
intel: An incredible system of six stars dancing in a complex gravitational ballet.

name: GACRUX
intel: The nearest Red Giant to Earth. Its color contrasts with the other blue stars in Crux.

name: BELLATRIX
intel: Orion's left shoulder. An aggressive star ejecting matter into space.

name: ELNATH
intel: Chemically peculiar. It has unusually high levels of Manganese.

name: MIAPLACIDUS
intel: Very stable orbit. No companion stars detected.

name: ALNILAM
intel: The center belt star. It illuminates the surrounding molecular clouds.

name: ALNITAK
intel: Source of intense radiation. The Horsehead Nebula is nearby.

name: ALIOTH
intel: Brightest star in the Big Dipper. Has a strange magnetic field.

name: DUBHE
intel: One of the 'Pointer Stars'. A line from here points directly to the North Star.

name: MIRFAK
intel: Moving through space with a large cluster of younger stars.

name: WEZEN
intel: A massive star. If it were closer, it would outshine the moon.

name: SARGAS
intel: Evolving rapidly. It is swelling up as it ages.

name: KAUS AUS
intel: Ejecting a shell of gas from its equator due to high spin speed.

name: AVIOR
intel: Two stars that eclipse each other. Visible only from the Southern Hemisphere.

name: ALKAID
intel: The tip of the handle. It is moving in a different direction than the rest of the Dipper.

name: MENKALINAN
intel: Two egg-shaped stars locked in a tight orbit, always facing each other.

name: ATRIA
intel: A deep convection zone mixes the star's elements thoroughly.

name: ALHENA
intel: Entering the end of its life. An asteroid belt likely orbits it.

name: PEACOCK
intel: Orbits a companion every 11 days. The system is young and chaotic.

name: ALSEPHINA
intel: A complex multiple star system with eclipsing components.

name: MIRZAM
intel: The 'Roarer'. It pulses and changes brightness every few hours.

name: ALPHARD
intel: The 'Solitary One'. It sits alone in a very empty part of the sky.

name: POLARIS
intel: The North Star. It stays fixed in the sky while others rotate around it.

name: HAMAL
intel: A giant planet (1.8x Jupiter mass) orbits this star.

name: ALGOL
intel: The 'Demon Star'. One star is sucking material off its neighbor, causing it to wink.

name: DIPHDA
intel: Surprisingly active for an old star. It emits large X-ray flares.

name: NUNKI
intel: Extremely hot surface temperature. Surrounded by interstellar gas.

name: ALPHECCA
intel: The 'Jewel'. A binary system where one star passes in front of the other.

name: SCHEDAR
intel: The bottom star of the 'W' shape. Very stable and bright.

name: ASPIDISKE
intel: A rare white supergiant. It is crossing a phase of instability.

name: SUHAIL
intel: Creating shockwaves in its own atmosphere. Will end as a supernova.

name: CAPH
intel: Rotates once a day. Its shape is flattened like a pumpkin.

name: RUCHBAH
intel: Emits excess infrared light, suggesting a disk of dust.

name: SEGIN
intel: A massive blue giant at the end of the 'W' constellation.

name: MERAK
intel: Surrounded by a disk of planetary debris. Planets may exist here.

name: PHECDA
intel: Surrounded by a gaseous envelope. It is blowing its atmosphere away.

name: MEGREZ
intel: The faintest star in the Big Dipper. It connects the handle to the bowl.

name: MIZAR
intel: Famous quadruple system. You can see its companion Alcor with the naked eye.

name: ALCOR
intel: The 'Rider' sitting on the horse (Mizar). A test of good eyesight.

name: KOCHAB
intel: A guardian of the pole. Contains a planet 6x heavier than Jupiter.

name: PHERKAD
intel: A bright shell star. Varying in brightness as it throws off gas.

name: MINTAKA
intel: The western star of Orion's belt. A binary system of massive stars.

name: SAIPH
intel: Orion's right knee. Hotter than Rigel but appears dimmer to our eyes.

name: GRAFFIAS
intel: A system of at least six stars. The moon often passes in front of it.

name: DSCHUBBA
intel: Unexpectedly flared in brightness in 2000. Throwing off a gas disk.

name: WEI
intel: An old giant star. It helps form the tail of the scorpion.

name: LESATH
intel: Located right next to Shaula. Dangerous radiation levels.

name: ALGIEBA
intel: A planet 9x the mass of Jupiter orbits this star.

name: ZOSMA
intel: Spinning rapidly. Located on the hip of the Lion.

name: ALBIREO
intel: The most beautiful double star in the sky. One is gold, the other is blue.

name: SADR
intel: Surrounded by a complex nebula. The heart of the Swan.

name: GIENAH
intel: A wing of the swan. Nearing the end of its life cycle.

name: MARKAB
intel: Infrared scans show a disk of debris. Likely has a planetary system.

name: SCHEAT
intel: Losing mass rapidly. Surrounded by a shell of gas/dust.

name: ALPHERATZ
intel: Chemical composition is strange. Features clouds of Mercury and Manganese.

name: MIRACH
intel: Used to find the Andromeda Galaxy. A 'Ghost Galaxy' appears right next to it.

name: ALMACH
intel: A stunning quadruple system. An orange giant with three blue companions.

name: MENKAR
intel: The star is unstable. It is fusing helium into carbon in its core.

name: KAUS MED
intel: The middle of the bow. Has three dim companion stars.

name: KAUS BOR
intel: The top of the bow. It wobbles, suggesting an unseen companion.

name: ALNASL
intel: The arrow tip. It is moving towards the center of the galaxy.

name: ASCELLA
intel: Binary system orbiting every 21 years. Part of the 'Teapot'.

name: POLIS
intel: Ideally avoided. Radiation levels are lethal. Distance is immense.

name: RUKBAT
intel: Excess infrared detected. Likely surrounded by asteroids.

name: ANCAA
intel: A binary system with a very short orbit.

name: ALUDRA
intel: A dying supergiant. It is shedding its outer layers into space.

name: MULIPHEIN
intel: A bright giant star, heavily evolved.

name: FURUD
intel: Spectroscopic binary. The companion is invisible to telescopes.

name: RASALHAGUE
intel: Spinning at 88% of break-up speed. The equator is bulging out.

name: CEBALRAI
intel: Variable brightness. A planet is suspected to be here.

name: SABIK
intel: Two stars in a very eccentric orbit. They swing close then far apart.

name: YED PRIOR
intel: Rich in Nitrogen. The surface is relatively cool.

name: MARFIK
intel: An eclipsing binary. The light dips regularly as they cross.

name: ETAMIN
intel: The 'Zenith Star' of London. Moving towards the Solar Apex.

name: ALDERAMIN
intel: Spinning fast. Will become the North Star around 7500 AD.

name: ALFIRK
intel: The surface pulses due to iron in the star's core.

name: ERRAI
intel: Home to planet 'Tadmor'. It orbits in the habitable zone.

name: TARAZED
intel: Rich in Carbon-13. Burning a helium core.

name: ALSHAIN
intel: Similar magnetic activity to the Sun. Has a red dwarf companion.

name: DENEB OKAB
intel: Rotating at 200km/s. The star is flattened by speed.

name: ROTANEV
intel: Two sub-giant stars. High metal content in the atmosphere.

name: SUALOCIN
intel: A system of seven stars interacting gravitationally.

name: ZUBENELGENUBI
intel: The stars are very far apart (5,000 AU). Easy to see with binoculars.

name: ZUBENESCHAMALI
intel: Often described as looking green, a rare optical illusion.

name: UNUKALHAI
intel: Emits surprisingly strong X-rays for an old star.

name: VINDEMIATRIX
intel: Moving through space very quickly. High X-ray output.

name: PORRIMA
intel: Twin stars. Their orbit is an ellipse, swinging them wildy.

name: COR CAROLI
intel: Incredibly strong magnetic field. It separates elements in its atmosphere.

name: IZAR
intel: Pulcherrima (The Most Beautiful). A bright orange giant with a blue partner.

name: MUPHRID
intel: Rich in heavy elements. Very close to Arcturus in the sky.

name: ALKALUROPS
intel: Triple system. The secondary star flares up in brightness.

name: NEKKAR
intel: A flare star. Expanding atmosphere detected.

name: SEGINUS
intel: The surface oscillates, changing shape as it rotates.
